description: Caller requests a slot that is already taken, accepts an alternative, and the booking succeeds.
turns: 8 October subah 9 baje Dr. Rao ke saath chahiye tha.

expected.notes: 09:00 on 2026-10-08 is taken (ap_0015). The caller corrects themselves in turn 2 and requests 09:15. A naive agent might try to book 09:00 without checking, creating a double-booking error. The correct flow: search_slots confirms 09:15 is free, book_appointment at 09:15 succeeds.
